Pinnacle Holdings Llc decreased its stake in Magellan Midstream (MMP) by 0.85% based on its latest 2017Q4 regulatory filing with the SEC. The hedge fund held 81,208 shares of the natural gas distribution company at the end of 2017Q4, valued at $5.76B, down from 81,908 at the end of the previous reported quarter. Pinnacle Holdings Llc who had been investing in Magellan Midstream for a number of months, seems to be less bullish one the $15.65 billion market cap company. The stock decreased 0.35% or $0.24 $68.6. About 818,977 shares traded. Magellan Midstream Partners, L.P. (NYSE:MMP) has declined 24.45% downtrending. It has underperformed by 36.00% the S&P500.
Pinnacle Holdings Llc, which manages about $720.48 million and $275.17 billion US Long portfolio, upped its stake in Citizens Community Bancorp (NASDAQ:CZWI) by 11,365 shares to 98,419 shares, valued at $1.33 billion in 2017Q4, according to the filing. It also increased its holding in Apple (NASDAQ:AAPL) by 46 shares in the quarter, for a total of 17,458 shares, and has risen its stake in Unisys Corp (NYSE:UIS).
Analysts await Magellan Midstream Partners, L.P. (NYSE:MMP) to report earnings on August, 1. They expect $1.00 earnings per share, up 8.70 % or $0.08 from last year’s $0.92 per share. MMP’s profit will be $228.19 million for 17.15 P/E if the $1.00 EPS becomes a reality. After $1.05 actual earnings per share reported by Magellan Midstream Partners, L.P. for the previous quarter, Wall Street now forecasts -4.76 % negative EPS growth.
